# Required setup

Use Python 3.10 or later, a text editor such as VS Code, and Quarto if you want to preview or render the guide. Download and extract this complete project ZIP. Do not work inside the compressed file. Open the folder containing `_quarto.yml`, `requirements.txt`, `scripts/` and `data/`, then open a terminal there.

## Create an environment

On macOS or Linux:

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
```

On Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
py -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
```

Install the analysis packages with the environment active:

```bash
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip check
python -c "import numpy, pandas, scipy, matplotlib, seaborn; print('Packages loaded.')"
```

## Check and run the synthetic example

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/synthetic --output-dir results/synthetic --check-only
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/synthetic --output-dir results/synthetic
python scripts/python/verify_variant.py data/synthetic results/synthetic SYN000001
```

The synthetic inputs are included; regeneration is optional:

```bash
python scripts/python/prepare_synthetic.py
```

Regeneration replaces the synthetic inputs. The seed and generator are recorded, but exact generated bytes can depend on package versions. Keep the bundled inputs and checksums for the reference results.

## Preview and render

Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) separately from Python. Run:

```bash
quarto preview
```

Open the address printed in the terminal. Press Ctrl+C to stop. To build `docs/`:

```bash
quarto render
```

The QMD pages show commands and existing results; rendering does not run the Python analysis. If inputs or parameters change, rerun Python before rendering.

## Common problems

| Problem | Check |
|---|---|
| File not found | Run commands from the main project folder |
| Package missing | Activate `.venv`, then reinstall requirements |
| Zero p-values | Recover source log-p-values or higher-precision values upstream; do not insert an arbitrary minimum |
| Odds ratios supplied | This beta-only starter cannot treat OR as beta; extend the method before use |
| Real-study input not found | That section is planned; no real data are bundled yet |

Use AI to explain errors or code, then check any proposed change against the input definitions and saved calculations.
